criteria.requirement: Add Path.read_hashes(algorithms,*,chunk_size=8192,hex=True), returning insertion-ordered algorithm->digest mapping. Materialize/deduplicate algorithm names, validate fixed-size hash objects and positive integer chunk size before opening, read one stream once and update every digest for each bounded chunk. Support empty/binary/large files and raw digest output, close stream on read errors and propagate them. Reject empty algorithms, bool sizes, unknown hashes and XOFs requiring a length; preserve old hash APIs.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
